B.Choice: The deer population increased as the carrying capacity stabilized. As the carrying capacity decreased, the deer population decreased.

C.Choice: As the deer population reached a maximum, so did the carrying capacity. As the deer population decreased, so did the carrying capacity until the environment stabilized and the deer population could increase again.

D.Choice: The deer population increased rapidly, quickly exceeding the carrying capacity. As the deer population increased, there was less food available, reducing the carrying capacity.
